f_01KXAVEN7XWTTJTKSHV0R9K1S7.subject: job_total_estimate
f_01KXAVEN7XWTTJTKSHV0R9K1S7.content: The breakdown estimates total project cost at $100,778.92: labor $45,167.59, materials $52,171.33, equipment $3,440.00.

f_01KXAVEN7XJ2KMXRQ49CE6V190.subject: job_labor_hours_total
f_01KXAVEN7XJ2KMXRQ49CE6V190.content: Total estimated labor across all sections is 1,287 hours.

f_01KXAVEN7XJRPAAKP6QBEHY8H6.subject: job_addition_footprint
f_01KXAVEN7XJRPAAKP6QBEHY8H6.content: The addition is a 30' x 10' two-story structure with an overall breakdown footprint of 789 sq ft at 8-foot ceiling height.

f_01KXAVEN7XGFP0BPFJMMR7ED2C.subject: scope_addition_program
f_01KXAVEN7XGFP0BPFJMMR7ED2C.content: The addition adds basement-level storage, a second-floor primary bedroom, master bathroom, and walk-in closet.

f_01KXAVEN7X4M9F9NPHJ5BBT5AE.subject: scope_septic_requirement
f_01KXAVEN7X4M9F9NPHJ5BBT5AE.content: TDEC septic inspection is required per scope; relocation, replacement, or grinder-pump costs are explicitly excluded and triggered only via change order.

f_01KXAVEN7XY6KJRA2C1SFVRVTJ.subject: scope_lvl_beam
f_01KXAVEN7XY6KJRA2C1SFVRVTJ.content: One 3-ply 14" LVL beam spanning approximately 15'-6" is required to open an existing load-bearing wall; temporary shoring is included.

f_01KXAVEN7XHH0WY372RRH7VXJD.subject: scope_elevator_shaft
f_01KXAVEN7XHH0WY372RRH7VXJD.content: A 4' x 4' elevator shaft is framed only; the elevator system itself is explicitly excluded from scope.

f_01KXAVEN7Y9VQBC137K830GW5V.subject: scope_roof_tie_in
f_01KXAVEN7Y9VQBC137K830GW5V.content: A new gable roof at approximately 3/12 pitch ties into the existing 6/12 pitch; framing method (truss vs. rafter) is TBD pending design-phase finalization.

f_01KXAVEN7YJZEJG3YXAC3W2EF6.subject: scope_subpanel
f_01KXAVEN7YJZEJG3YXAC3W2EF6.content: A 100-amp electrical subpanel with full rough-in and trim-out is included in scope.

f_01KXAVEN7YX72M0Q134QW3AX66.subject: scope_hvac_mini_split
f_01KXAVEN7YX72M0Q134QW3AX66.content: The HVAC/mechanical breakdown section is titled 'HVAC – Mini Split, Tankless WH & Relocations' at $6,503.36; this includes heat pump relocation per scope.

f_01KXAVEN7Y2MZXJYB7NMHHXJAY.subject: scope_retrofit_section
f_01KXAVEN7Y2MZXJYB7NMHHXJAY.content: The breakdown includes an 'Existing Hall Bath Mod, Bedroom Remodel & Closeout' retrofit section with 72 labor hours and an anomalous material cost of -$4,199.00, producing a section total of -$1,714.20.

f_01KXAVEN7YT6VPNG2G0WTAJQA8.subject: scope_change_order_exclusions
f_01KXAVEN7YT6VPNG2G0WTAJQA8.content: Explicit change-order exclusions in the scope are: rock excavation, unsuitable soils, concealed conditions (wiring, plumbing, structural), septic relocation/replacement, and the elevator system.

f_01KXAVEN7Y9GJ9ZNMERVEDWDNR.subject: drawings_designer
f_01KXAVEN7Y9GJ9ZNMERVEDWDNR.content: Architectural elevation drawings are credited to Francisco Guerrero, NCIDQ (Interior Designer); phone 571-740-3897.

f_01KXAVEN7YKAXR8D0BFSD74RZ4.subject: job_scheduled_start_date
f_01KXAVEN7YKAXR8D0BFSD74RZ4.content: Job is scheduled to start 2026-10-05, which is 85 calendar days from today (2026-07-12).

f_01KXAVEN7YA23T3GMH40PATD3C.subject: scope_windows
f_01KXAVEN7YA23T3GMH40PATD3C.content: Four windows are in scope: three at 36" x 60" and one transom, plus one new exterior door.
